mapper.sql: select id, product_id, product_key, version, metadata_snapshot, change_type, change_description, operator, create_time from iot_product_metadata_version
mapper.select: where product_id = #{productId} order by version desc

select v.id, v.product_id, v.product_key, v.version, cast(v.metadata_snapshot as varchar) as metadata_snapshot, v.change_type, v.change_description, v.operator, v.create_time, p.name as product_name from iot_product_metadata_version v left join iot_product p on v.product_id = p.id where v.product_key = #{productKey} order by v.version desc

select v.id, v.product_id, v.product_key, v.version, cast(v.metadata_snapshot as varchar) as metadata_snapshot, v.change_type, v.change_description, v.operator, v.create_time, p.name as product_name from iot_product_metadata_version v left join iot_product p on v.product_id = p.id where v.id = #{id}

select v.id, v.product_id, v.product_key, v.version, cast(v.metadata_snapshot as varchar) as metadata_snapshot, v.change_type, v.change_description, v.operator, v.create_time, p.name as product_name from iot_product_metadata_version v left join iot_product p on v.product_id = p.id where v.product_id = #{productId} order by v.version desc limit 1
